verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents domestic wires through a Wire Transfer object with status tracking, and has a FedNow page describing instant 24/7/365 settlement, so two of the three faster rails appear in the same API docs. RTP is not evidenced at all, and nothing shows how origination versus receipt works on either rail. Missing for 10: RTP support, explicit origination and receipt documentation for wires and FedNow, per-rail capability details (limits, cutoffs, receive handling), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the faster rails are there when I need them — domestic wires, RTP, and FedNow origination and receipt through the same API, with per-rail capabilities documented

citations.quote: Wires are electronic funds transfers between two accounts at different financial institutions... You can track the progress of a wire by checking the `status` attribute on the Wire Transfer object.
Instant Settlement: Payments settle within seconds, 24/7/365
